questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter/number that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter ‘U’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a2a0a3fd731b83d1dd3712d4cc93e7b51739328b4b0b4bf8c7a62c098f36513.png]
questions.solution: From figure I and II we take common letter E, then take clock wise direction from the common point E. A is opposite to 9, I is opposite to O, and E is opposite to U. And, from II and III we take common letter 9, then take clock wise direction from the common point 9. O is opposite to I, E is opposite to U, and 9 is opposite to A. Similarly, from III and I we take common letter I, then take clock wise direction from the common point I. U is opposite to E, 9 is opposite to A, and I is opposite to O.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the having '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e07ac5cf8cb626cd08ee2e8393f9b3830c52735da24ffe3d4f32b33db994fff4.png]
questions.solution:
For this question, the relation is given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf80a01bba8f76e28fddbcedf2352d5a2fe28a07f201bd951736ef8c10953662.png] 

 
 

 Dice A
 Dice B
 
 

 **5**
 **6**
 
 

 3
 2
 
 

 1
 4
 
 

 

From figure (A) and figure (B), only 5 is common.

Now we take clockwise direction from 5 in figure (A) and figure (B) respectively, then letter opposite to each other.

From figure (A) take a clockwise direction from 5 which is 3 and 1 respectively.

From figure (B) take a clockwise direction from 5 which is 2 and 4 respectively.

From figure (A) 3 is opposite to figure (B) 2.

From figure (A) 1 is opposite to figure (B) 4.

**From figure (A) 5 is opposite to figure (B) 6.**

Hence, "6" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the figure, what will come opposite to face containing ‘N’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5530f6e6dac17ddc77f5b4940d14f0d2442419dd9649222dd38e92f6edb4e64f.png]
questions.solution:
if we consider face with “W” as centre and fold its surrounding faces inside, we find that face with “P” and “N”, “N” and “Q”, “Q” and “W”, “W” and “S” and “S” and “R” are adjacent face this shows face with “P” and “W” opposite to each other, face with “Q” and “R” opposite to each other and face “N” and “S” are opposite to each other.

Thus, face opposite to “N” is face containing “S”.
